clue.text: Each one dropped a type of anesthetic

explanation.definitionFit: Ether was one of the earliest general anesthetics, inhaled to put surgical patients to sleep.

explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks dress Beeswax up as a song title; the definition is the material itself, arranged in cells.

clue.text: Torment a lamb, in part

explanation.definitionFit: To reiterate is to say or do something over again, repeating a statement already made.

clue.text: In the military, time off before operation gets one a little water

clue.text: Where to find this woman's name?

clue.text: Listening to a Japanese teenager, possibly putting someone out of their misery

clue.text: Preparing for a trip around the outskirts of Nagasaki in a state of extreme fear

clue.text: Capital spot, said to be shifted two degrees
